title: creating a Page asks one question, its kind

criteria.text: Creating a Page asks one question, its kind: each kind is a question with a one-line purpose, and the screen says this just starts the process
criteria.note: `WhatAreYouStarting.tsx`: 'What are you starting?', four answers each with a one-line purpose, and 'This just gets things started' [V]. The fourth, 'Be creative', is Don's own wording and the one answer that is not a question (ruled 2026-10-05). Built by #326 (Reviewed by), #364 and #382 (both review-skipped); deploy-health green on all three. Checked: unmarked `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx`; nothing asserts the 'just gets things started' sentence (#575). Smoked: smoke-live has no route for /create or the draft Page publish card [V evals/screens/routes.ts]

criteria.text: Creation lands the owner on their draft Page, where they fill in everything else, the name included
criteria.note: `startDraftAction` makes a draft of the chosen purpose and redirects to `canonicalPagePath` [V create/actions.ts]; the draft Page shows 'Before you publish' (name, where, description, tags, photo) and edits in place (#326, #360). Built by #326 (Reviewed by) and #360 (review-skipped). Checked: unmarked `create/actions.test.ts` ('creates a draft … and lands on it'); nothing asserts the draft offers name, address and tags (#575).

criteria.text: A Page's map and card placement comes from a single resolver evaluated at read time; nothing precomputed or cached
criteria.note: `resolvePagePlacements` in `src/lib/groups/resolve-page-placement.ts`, used by `resolveShop`; no placement column or cache in the migrations (the word appears only in comments) [V grep]. Built by T143 (commit f244852, a direct commit with no PR, so no review) with no deploy-health run on it. `resolve-page-placement.test.ts` tests shape, not the absence of stored placement (#576).
